## Checklist

- [ ] No user input leaves the browser: no network calls, no analytics, no telemetry
- [ ] `pnpm lint` passes
- [ ] `pnpm typecheck` passes
- [ ] `pnpm test` passes, and new logic has tests (bug fixes have a regression test)
- [ ] `pnpm build` passes
- [ ] Commit messages are `feat: ...` or `fix: ...`, two sentences at most
- [ ] Any new dependency is named below with a reason the platform can't cover it
